comments.text:
Aditya Birla Health’s ICR is 68 % in FY 23-24—well inside the 60-80 % zone that balances claim payouts with premium stability. For context, the previous two years were 69.6 % and 64.7 % (three-year average ≈ 67 %), so there’s no scary slide. 

Pair that with a ~93 % claim-settlement ratio (CSR) and only ≈ 22 complaints per 10 k claims, and Aditya Birla still sits comfortably among the top stand-alone insurers.
